CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)

   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.

   D. Use Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
